title: How Elon Musk gained so much power over U.S. security interests
summary: SpaceX's speed limits on Starshield receivers are still hurting Ukraine's drone operations, and no other company can supply the same technology. Officials, Elon Musk and President Trump give conflicting accounts of who ordered the restriction. Retired Colonel Charles Galbreath explains why a government-run military system shouldn't be controlled by a private owner, how dependent the Pentagon has become on SpaceX, and why he wants an investigation and stronger oversight.
focus: Shadow Colonel Galbreath's explanation of the difference between Starlink and Starshield and his 'bottom line' answer on oversight: a clear structure (context, problem, recommendation) that maps well onto consulting storylines.
